output.reason: [ev-cf5b10ff8047] and [ev-d3850c78b94e] show that between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0 the updaterequests.kyverno.io CRD switches its storage version from v1beta1 to v2. The change text says existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten and status.storedVersions is updated. The clusters that still need this migration are the ones whose CRD status.storedVersions still lists v1beta1. The proposed condition checks exactly that, using the standard condition for migrating a CRD's stored objects.
